the diffractive cross section for heavy-quark production is dominated by a large contribution from the aligned-jet region, and by a large contribution with a large momentum transfer to both the target and the projectile.

the color singlet cross section for DIS off a heavy quark has a leading twist component only in the aligned jet region.
